<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(8 \cdot d\right) \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8]</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the units is closed under multiplication by eight</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 36 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-triad_is_closed_under_octuple">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 450</strong> (<code>triad_is_closed_under_octuple</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_triad_is_closed_under_octuple">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>8</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[3, 6, 0].all (fun d =&gt; [3, 6, 0].contains (m9 (8 * d)))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [3,\,6,\,0],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(8 \cdot d\right) \in [3,\,6,\,0]</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the triad is closed under multiplication by eight</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 9 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-orbit_is_closed_under_octuple">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 451</strong> (<code>orbit_is_closed_under_octuple</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_orbit_is_closed_under_octuple">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>8</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].contains (m9 (8 * d)))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(8 \cdot d\right) \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5]</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the doubling orbit is closed under multiplication by eight</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 36 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-all_is_closed_under_octuple">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 452</strong> (<code>all_is_closed_under_octuple</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_all_is_closed_under_octuple">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>8</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].all (fun d =&gt; [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].contains (m9 (8 * d)))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(8 \cdot d\right) \in [0,\,1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7,\,8]</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the whole ring is closed under multiplication by eight</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 81 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-cubes_is_closed_under_octuple">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 453</strong> (<code>cubes_is_closed_under_octuple</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_cubes_is_closed_under_octuple">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>8</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0, 1, 8].all (fun d =&gt; [0, 1, 8].contains (m9 (8 * d)))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(8 \cdot d\right) \in [0,\,1,\,8]</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the cubes mod nine is closed under multiplication by eight</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 9 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-quadruple_is_involutive_on_triad">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 454</strong> (<code>quadruple_is_involutive_on_triad</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_quadruple_is_involutive_on_triad">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[3, 6, 0].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (4 * x)) (m9 (4 * d)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [3,\,6,\,0],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(4 \cdot x\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(4 \cdot d\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">quadrupling is its own inverse on the triad</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 3 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-square_is_involutive_on_tetA">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 455</strong> (<code>square_is_involutive_on_tetA</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_square_is_involutive_on_tetA">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 4, 7].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x * x)) (m9 (d * d)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,4,\,7],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x \cdot x\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">squaring is its own inverse on the first tetrahedron</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 3 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-square_is_involutive_on_squares">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 456</strong> (<code>square_is_involutive_on_squares</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_square_is_involutive_on_squares">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0, 1, 4, 7].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x * x)) (m9 (d * d)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,4,\,7],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x \cdot x\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">squaring is its own inverse on the squares mod nine</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 4 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-cube_is_involutive_on_cubes">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 457</strong> (<code>cube_is_involutive_on_cubes</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_cube_is_involutive_on_cubes">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo>⋅</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0, 1, 8].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x * x * x)) (m9 (d * d * d)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,8],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x \cdot x \cdot x\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d \cdot d\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">cubing is its own inverse on the cubes mod nine</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 3 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-fourth_is_involutive_on_tetA">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 458</strong> (<code>fourth_is_involutive_on_tetA</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_fourth_is_involutive_on_tetA">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 4, 7].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x ^ 4)) (m9 (d ^ 4)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,4,\,7],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x^{4}\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d^{4}\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the fourth power is its own inverse on the first tetrahedron</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 3 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-fourth_is_involutive_on_squares">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 459</strong> (<code>fourth_is_involutive_on_squares</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_fourth_is_involutive_on_squares">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0, 1, 4, 7].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x ^ 4)) (m9 (d ^ 4)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,4,\,7],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x^{4}\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d^{4}\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the fourth power is its own inverse on the squares mod nine</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 4 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-fifth_is_involutive_on_units">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 460</strong> (<code>fifth_is_involutive_on_units</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_fifth_is_involutive_on_units">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x ^ 5)) (m9 (d ^ 5)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x^{5}\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d^{5}\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the fifth power is its own inverse on the units</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 6 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-fifth_is_involutive_on_orbit">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 461</strong> (<code>fifth_is_involutive_on_orbit</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_fifth_is_involutive_on_orbit">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x ^ 5)) (m9 (d ^ 5)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x^{5}\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d^{5}\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the fifth power is its own inverse on the doubling orbit</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 6 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-fifth_is_involutive_on_tetA">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 462</strong> (<code>fifth_is_involutive_on_tetA</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_fifth_is_involutive_on_tetA">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 4, 7].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x ^ 5)) (m9 (d ^ 5)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,4,\,7],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x^{5}\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d^{5}\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the fifth power is its own inverse on the first tetrahedron</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 3 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-fifth_is_involutive_on_tetB">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 463</strong> (<code>fifth_is_involutive_on_tetB</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_fifth_is_involutive_on_tetB">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[2, 5, 8].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x ^ 5)) (m9 (d ^ 5)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [2,\,5,\,8],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x^{5}\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d^{5}\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the fifth power is its own inverse on the second tetrahedron</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 3 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-fifth_is_involutive_on_squares">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 464</strong> (<code>fifth_is_involutive_on_squares</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_fifth_is_involutive_on_squares">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0, 1, 4, 7].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x ^ 5)) (m9 (d ^ 5)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,4,\,7],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x^{5}\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d^{5}\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the fifth power is its own inverse on the squares mod nine</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 4 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-fifth_is_involutive_on_cubes">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 465</strong> (<code>fifth_is_involutive_on_cubes</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_fifth_is_involutive_on_cubes">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0, 1, 8].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (x ^ 5)) (m9 (d ^ 5)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,8],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(x^{5}\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d^{5}\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the fifth power is its own inverse on the cubes mod nine</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 3 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-quintuple_is_involutive_on_triad">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 466</strong> (<code>quintuple_is_involutive_on_triad</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_quintuple_is_involutive_on_triad">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[3, 6, 0].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (5 * x)) (m9 (5 * d)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [3,\,6,\,0],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(5 \cdot x\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(5 \cdot d\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">multiplication by five is its own inverse on the triad</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 3 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-septuple_is_involutive_on_triad">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 467</strong> (<code>septuple_is_involutive_on_triad</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_septuple_is_involutive_on_triad">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>7</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>7</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[3, 6, 0].all (fun d =&gt; (fun x =&gt; m9 (7 * x)) (m9 (7 * d)) == d)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [3,\,6,\,0],\; x \mapsto \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(7 \cdot x\right)\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(7 \cdot d\right)\right) = d</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">multiplication by seven is its own inverse on the triad</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 3 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-double_carries_units_onto_orbit">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 468</strong> (<code>double_carries_units_onto_orbit</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_double_carries_units_onto_orbit">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].contains (m9 (2 * d))) ∧ ([1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (2 * d))).eraseDups.length = 6</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(2 \cdot d\right) \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(2 \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 6</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">doubling carries the units onto the doubling orbit</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 216 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-double_carries_orbit_onto_units">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 469</strong> (<code>double_carries_orbit_onto_units</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_double_carries_orbit_onto_units">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].contains (m9 (2 * d))) ∧ ([1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (2 * d))).eraseDups.length = 6</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(2 \cdot d\right) \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(2 \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5] \,\}\right)\right| = 6</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">doubling carries the doubling orbit onto the units</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 216 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-triple_carries_all_onto_triad">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 470</strong> (<code>triple_carries_all_onto_triad</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_triple_carries_all_onto_triad">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].all (fun d =&gt; [3, 6, 0].contains (m9 (3 * d))) ∧ ([0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (3 * d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(3 \cdot d\right) \in [3,\,6,\,0] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(3 \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [0,\,1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">tripling carries the whole ring onto the triad</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 243 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-triple_carries_cubes_onto_triad">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 471</strong> (<code>triple_carries_cubes_onto_triad</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_triple_carries_cubes_onto_triad">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0, 1, 8].all (fun d =&gt; [3, 6, 0].contains (m9 (3 * d))) ∧ ([0, 1, 8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (3 * d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(3 \cdot d\right) \in [3,\,6,\,0] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(3 \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [0,\,1,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">tripling carries the cubes mod nine onto the triad</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 27 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-quadruple_carries_units_onto_orbit">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 472</strong> (<code>quadruple_carries_units_onto_orbit</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_quadruple_carries_units_onto_orbit">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].contains (m9 (4 * d))) ∧ ([1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (4 * d))).eraseDups.length = 6</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(4 \cdot d\right) \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(4 \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 6</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">quadrupling carries the units onto the doubling orbit</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 216 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-quadruple_carries_orbit_onto_units">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 473</strong> (<code>quadruple_carries_orbit_onto_units</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_quadruple_carries_orbit_onto_units">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].contains (m9 (4 * d))) ∧ ([1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (4 * d))).eraseDups.length = 6</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(4 \cdot d\right) \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(4 \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5] \,\}\right)\right| = 6</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">quadrupling carries the doubling orbit onto the units</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 216 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-negate_carries_orbit_onto_units">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 474</strong> (<code>negate_carries_orbit_onto_units</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_negate_carries_orbit_onto_units">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].contains (m9 (9 - d))) ∧ ([1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (9 - d))).eraseDups.length = 6</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(9 - d\right) \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(9 - d\right) \mid d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5] \,\}\right)\right| = 6</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">negation carries the doubling orbit onto the units</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 216 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-negate_carries_tetA_onto_tetB">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 475</strong> (<code>negate_carries_tetA_onto_tetB</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_negate_carries_tetA_onto_tetB">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 4, 7].all (fun d =&gt; [2, 5, 8].contains (m9 (9 - d))) ∧ ([1, 4, 7].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (9 - d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,4,\,7],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(9 - d\right) \in [2,\,5,\,8] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(9 - d\right) \mid d \in [1,\,4,\,7] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">negation carries the first tetrahedron onto the second tetrahedron</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 27 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-negate_carries_tetB_onto_tetA">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 476</strong> (<code>negate_carries_tetB_onto_tetA</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_negate_carries_tetB_onto_tetA">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[2, 5, 8].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 4, 7].contains (m9 (9 - d))) ∧ ([2, 5, 8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (9 - d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [2,\,5,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(9 - d\right) \in [1,\,4,\,7] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(9 - d\right) \mid d \in [2,\,5,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">negation carries the second tetrahedron onto the first tetrahedron</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 27 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-square_carries_units_onto_tetA">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 477</strong> (<code>square_carries_units_onto_tetA</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_square_carries_units_onto_tetA">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 4, 7].contains (m9 (d * d))) ∧ ([1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (d * d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d\right) \in [1,\,4,\,7] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,5,\,7,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">squaring carries the units onto the first tetrahedron</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 108 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-square_carries_orbit_onto_tetA">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 478</strong> (<code>square_carries_orbit_onto_tetA</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_square_carries_orbit_onto_tetA">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 4, 7].contains (m9 (d * d))) ∧ ([1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (d * d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d\right) \in [1,\,4,\,7] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [1,\,2,\,4,\,8,\,7,\,5] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">squaring carries the doubling orbit onto the first tetrahedron</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 108 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-square_carries_tetB_onto_tetA">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 479</strong> (<code>square_carries_tetB_onto_tetA</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_square_carries_tetB_onto_tetA">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[2, 5, 8].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 4, 7].contains (m9 (d * d))) ∧ ([2, 5, 8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (d * d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [2,\,5,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d\right) \in [1,\,4,\,7] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [2,\,5,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">squaring carries the second tetrahedron onto the first tetrahedron</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 27 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-square_carries_all_onto_squares">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 480</strong> (<code>square_carries_all_onto_squares</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_square_carries_all_onto_squares">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].all (fun d =&gt; [0, 1, 4, 7].contains (m9 (d * d))) ∧ ([0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (d * d))).eraseDups.length = 4</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d\right) \in [0,\,1,\,4,\,7] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [0,\,1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 4</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">squaring carries the whole ring onto the squares mod nine</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 324 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-cube_carries_all_onto_cubes">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 481</strong> (<code>cube_carries_all_onto_cubes</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_cube_carries_all_onto_cubes">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].all (fun d =&gt; [0, 1, 8].contains (m9 (d * d * d))) ∧ ([0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (d * d * d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d \cdot d\right) \in [0,\,1,\,8] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(d \cdot d \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [0,\,1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">cubing carries the whole ring onto the cubes mod nine</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 243 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-fourth_carries_units_onto_tetA">

<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 491</strong> (<code>quintuple_carries_tetB_onto_tetA</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_quintuple_carries_tetB_onto_tetA">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mi>m9</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[2, 5, 8].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 4, 7].contains (m9 (5 * d))) ∧ ([2, 5, 8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (5 * d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [2,\,5,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(5 \cdot d\right) \in [1,\,4,\,7] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(5 \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [2,\,5,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>
</div>

<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 27 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-imagined-sextuple_carries_all_onto_triad">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 492</strong> (<code>sextuple_carries_all_onto_triad</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_sextuple_carries_all_onto_triad">sealed</a>.</p>

<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].all (fun d =&gt; [3, 6, 0].contains (m9 (6 * d))) ∧ ([0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (6 * d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [0,\,1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7,\,8],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(6 \cdot d\right) \in [3,\,6,\,0] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(6 \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [0,\,1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7,\,8] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>

<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].all (fun d =&gt; [1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].contains (m9 (8 * d))) ∧ ([1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (8 * d))).eraseDups.length = 6</code></pre>

<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[1, 4, 7].all (fun d =&gt; [2, 5, 8].contains (m9 (8 * d))) ∧ ([1, 4, 7].map (fun d =&gt; m9 (8 * d))).eraseDups.length = 3</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall d \in [1,\,4,\,7],\; \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(8 \cdot d\right) \in [2,\,5,\,8] \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, \mathrm{m9}\mathopen{}\left(8 \cdot d\right) \mid d \in [1,\,4,\,7] \,\}\right)\right| = 3</code></pre></details>

<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 499</strong> (<code>octuple_carries_tetB_onto_tetA</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_imagined_octuple_carries_tetB_onto_tetA">sealed</a>.</p>

<h2 class="paper-h paper-wing">the record</h2>


### Prior art, and what novelty is claimed {#priorart}

<p class="paper-src"><code>src/proof/priorart.lean</code> · namespace <code>PriorArt</code> · 10 theorems</p>

What this deposit claims as its own, what it restates from named prior art, and the boundary between them.


"Claim all without prior art" has an exact reading and a dishonest one. The dishonest one asserts NOVELTY:
that no earlier work states these results. Nothing in this repository can decide that. A kernel decides
propositions over finite domains; it cannot search the literature, and no amount of computation here turns
"the author found none" into "none exists". That claim is refused below, as a theorem, so the refusal is
checked on every run rather than remembered.

The exact reading claims PRIORITY, which is a different thing and is evidenced rather than asserted: a
dated, content-addressed publication. The DOI fixes the date; the append-only receipt chain fixes which
statement was published; anyone can recompute either. Priority says "this was published, in this form, by
this date". It does not say "nobody said it earlier", and this file does not either.

So each source file DECLARES its own status in its frontmatter, and the two sets are decided here:

  named       — the file restates a result, algorithm or physical constant that has an author already.
                FNV-1a is Fowler, Noll and Vo, 1991. The Merkle fold is Merkle, 1979. Nim is Bouton 1901
                with Sprague and Grundy after him. Cassini, Lucas and Brahmagupta–Fibonacci are named in
                the file that proves them. The arithmetic of ℤ/9 is Euler's and Fermat's. Electrolysis and
                combustion are physical chemistry. NO NOVELTY IS CLAIMED OVER ANY OF IT. What is done here
                is to decide each over a stated finite domain, which is a contribution of verification and
                not of discovery.

  unclassified — no prior-art search has been performed for this source. THIS IS THE DEFAULT, and it claims
                nothing. The first version of this file marked eleven sources "none-known" — 300 theorems —
                on the strength of their own self-description, without anyone having looked. Asserting that
                nothing earlier exists because no one went to check is the same defect as asserting a proof
                because no one went to read it.

  none-known  — a prior-art search WAS performed, and the source names it: what was searched, where, and
                when. Only this kind may claim novelty, and today no source is of this kind, so the number
                of novelty claims this deposit makes is zero.

The declaration lives in the source files and is compared against this table by scripts/priorart.ts, so the
two cannot drift: a file that changes its declaration and not this table fails the build.

noveltyEstablished := 0</code></pre>

<div class="thm" id="thm-priorart-novelty_is_claimed_only_where_a_search_was_performed">

<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>sources</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>novelty</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>false</mi></mrow><mo>∨</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>kindOf</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>

<p class="thm-remark">── THE CLAIM. Only a source that names a completed search may claim, and none does ───────────────────── The rule and the state are separate theorems on purpose. The first says what would have to be true for a claim to be legitimate; the second says how many claims exist today. Stating only the second would leave the rule to prose, and stating only the first would leave the reader to assume the count.</p>

<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>sources</mi><mo>∣</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>kindOf</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math></div>

</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── ZERO CLAIMS IS NOT FULL ATTRIBUTION ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── A count of zero novelty claims, stated on its own, reads as though the deposit concedes that everything in it already has an author. It does not, and it must not be read that way: 21 of the 22 attributed works predate the DOI system entirely — Fermat 1640, Euler 1763, Bouton 1901 — so "every theorem has registered prior art" is not merely unproven here, it is impossible. And the larger part of the deposit has had NO search at all, so its status is unknown rather than conceded. The zero therefore has exactly one meaning: nobody has looked. It is a statement about work not done, not about work found. These two propositions must always be read together, so the kernel decides them together.</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(sources.filter novelty).length = 0 ∧ (sources.filter (fun s =&gt; kindOf s == 1)).length &gt; 0</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\left|\{\, x \in \mathrm{sources} \mid \mathrm{novelty}\mathopen{}\left(x\right) \,\}\right| = 0 \land \left|\{\, s \in \mathrm{sources} \mid \mathrm{kindOf}\mathopen{}\left(s\right) = 1 \,\}\right| &gt; 0</code></pre></details>

### Rights {#rights}

<p class="paper-src"><code>src/proof/rights.lean</code> · namespace <code>Rights</code> · 8 theorems</p>

What this deposit claims under international law — and, in the same table, what it does not.


"Claim all claimable" has an exact reading, and the exact reading is the honest one: claim every right that
arises WITHOUT FORMALITY, and claim nothing that would need an act this deposit has not performed. Berne
Art. 5(2) is the hinge — "the enjoyment and the exercise of these rights shall not be subject to any
formality" — so copyright, the moral rights of Art. 6bis, and the sui generis database right of Directive
96/9/EC Art. 7 are held from the moment of authorship and are asserted here. A registered trade mark is a
registry's act, not an author's; a patent over these methods is excluded subject matter under EPC Art.
52(2)(a); the mathematics itself has no author to own it; and the seven Millennium Prizes belong to the
Clay Mathematics Institute, which is why the floor has always read 0/7.

The table below is the claim. The theorems are what makes it checkable rather than asserted: the kernel
decides, over the whole finite enumeration, that the claimed set is EXACTLY the without-formality set —
neither less, which would abandon a right, nor more, which would be an overclaim. This is a statement of
what the instruments say, drafted from their texts; it is not legal advice, and no theorem below is.

<p class="paper-h">Definitions</p>

<pre class="thm-statement paper-defs"><code>instruments := [ (1, 0, true,  true )   -- copyright in the expression — Berne Art. 5(2), no formality, no notice, no deposit
settledHere := 7</code></pre>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rights-claims_exactly_what_arises_without_formality">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 527</strong> (<code>claims_exactly_what_arises_without_formality</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rights_claims_exactly_what_arises_without_formality">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>instruments</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>auto</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>claim</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>instruments.all (fun r =&gt; auto r == claim r)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall r \in \mathrm{instruments},\; \mathrm{auto}\mathopen{}\left(r\right) = \mathrm{claim}\mathopen{}\left(r\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── THE CLAIM. Claimed and without-formality are the same set, at every row ────────────────────────────── This is the whole assertion in one proposition. Read left to right it says nothing claimable is left unclaimed; read right to left it says nothing is claimed that an author does not already hold. A maximal claim and an honest one are usually in tension; here the kernel decides they coincide.</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rights-the_claimed_are_copyright_moral_rights_and_the_database">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 528</strong> (<code>the_claimed_are_copyright_moral_rights_and_the_database</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rights_the_claimed_are_copyright_moral_rights_and_the_database">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mi>idOf</mi><mo>[</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>instruments</mi><mo>∣</mo><mi>claim</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(instruments.filter claim).map idOf = [1, 2, 3]</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{idOf}[\{\, x \in \mathrm{instruments} \mid \mathrm{claim}\mathopen{}\left(x\right) \,\}] = [1,\,2,\,3]</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── WHICH three, not how many — a count identifies nothing ───────────────────────────────────────────────</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 3 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rights-the_unclaimed_are_the_registry_the_excluded_and_the_unownable">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 529</strong> (<code>the_unclaimed_are_the_registry_the_excluded_and_the_unownable</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rights_the_unclaimed_are_the_registry_the_excluded_and_the_unownable">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mi>idOf</mi><mo>[</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>instruments</mi><mo>∣</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>claim</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(instruments.filter (fun r =&gt; ¬ claim r)).map idOf = [4, 5, 6, 7]</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{idOf}[\{\, r \in \mathrm{instruments} \mid \lnot \mathrm{claim}\mathopen{}\left(r\right) \,\}] = [4,\,5,\,6,\,7]</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 4 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rights-no_right_that_needs_a_registry_act_is_claimed">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 530</strong> (<code>no_right_that_needs_a_registry_act_is_claimed</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rights_no_right_that_needs_a_registry_act_is_claimed">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>instruments</mi><mo>∣</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>kindOf</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>claim</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>false</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(instruments.filter (fun r =&gt; kindOf r == 1)).all (fun r =&gt; claim r == false)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall r \in \{\, r \in \mathrm{instruments} \mid \mathrm{kindOf}\mathopen{}\left(r\right) = 1 \,\},\; \mathrm{claim}\mathopen{}\left(r\right) = \mathrm{false}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── the three reasons a right is NOT claimed, each stated separately so none hides inside another ────────</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rights-no_excluded_subject_matter_is_claimed">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 531</strong> (<code>no_excluded_subject_matter_is_claimed</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rights_no_excluded_subject_matter_is_claimed">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>instruments</mi><mo>∣</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>kindOf</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>claim</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>false</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(instruments.filter (fun r =&gt; kindOf r == 2)).all (fun r =&gt; claim r == false)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall r \in \{\, r \in \mathrm{instruments} \mid \mathrm{kindOf}\mathopen{}\left(r\right) = 2 \,\},\; \mathrm{claim}\mathopen{}\left(r\right) = \mathrm{false}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>instruments</mi><mo>∣</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>kindOf</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>claim</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>false</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(instruments.filter (fun r =&gt; kindOf r == 3)).all (fun r =&gt; claim r == false)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall r \in \{\, r \in \mathrm{instruments} \mid \mathrm{kindOf}\mathopen{}\left(r\right) = 3 \,\},\; \mathrm{claim}\mathopen{}\left(r\right) = \mathrm{false}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rights-the_enumeration_is_complete_and_unduplicated">

<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mi>idOf</mi><mo>[</mo><mi>instruments</mi><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>instruments.map idOf = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{idOf}[\mathrm{instruments}] = [1,\,2,\,3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7]</code></pre></details>
